task: Task 11 — P2 quarantine, client projection, legacy-route containment; extended by Task 12 to ENFORCE the src/core/api export subsystem (CUTLIST_CSV/DXF_R12/GCODE/STEP zipBase64), closing the Task 11 carry-forward. No deferred BLOCK surfaces remain. Extended by Repair Phase 0 Task 6: legacy signed-URL download, direct artifact byte routes, client-selected OCR raw_uri, and broad installation-media DB policies are BLOCK with REPAIR_PHASE_NOT_ENABLED / migration-0190 enforcement.
policy: Every reachable build/export/download surface plus profile/tool/policy/JWT/storage-signing authority input is inventoried. A human or client can never reach P2 plaintext, a raw storage locator, or a reusable signed URL, and only one mutable release authority (0182 release_revision, reached via the V3 edge) exists. Dispositions: REUSE non-authoritative primitive | ADAPT reused under V3 contract | READ_ONLY history/inspection with no production-shaped output | BLOCK client download / FROZEN manufacturing export / duplicate authority / any bypass.
knownEgressNote: Reviewed baseline of files that carry a browser file-download signature (blob object URL + anchor download + click) as of this ledger version. The trust-kernel-scoped egress surfaces are ENFORCED (see routes + requiredMarkers, guarded by assertNotProductionShaped / assertExportFormatNotProductionShaped). The files below are pre-existing MONOLITH design/manufacturing export surfaces outside the Task 11/12 trust-kernel file scope; they are recorded here so the open-world egress sweep (verify-route-ledger.mjs §7) FAILS on any NEW, unreviewed egress file. Adding a new egress surface requires either enforcing it or consciously adding it here.
